annotations.title: Check what a TikTok account allows

description: For one connected TikTok account: the privacy levels it can use, whether comments, duets and stitches are allowed, and the longest video. Call this before posting to TikTok, because tiktokPrivacyLevel is required and must be one of the levels returned.
